name: 工时与项目成本管理系统

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Spring Boot API (profiles local,api) on http://127.0.0.1:8080. Builds an immutable JAR snapshot, runs Flyway migrations and local seed, then serves.

terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: bash -lc 'until [ -f .local/run/api-artifact.path ] && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 3; done; ./scripts/start-local-worker.sh'
terminals.description: Background worker (profiles local,worker). Waits for the API artifact and health, then reuses the same JAR snapshot to run auto-submit, closing, exports and reminders.

terminals.name: admin
terminals.description: Vue 3 + Element Plus admin console on http://127.0.0.1:5175/admin/ (proxies /api to 8080).

terminals.name: h5
terminals.description: Vue 3 + Vant mobile H5 layout on http://127.0.0.1:5174/h5/ (proxies /api to 8080).
